historical_references.reference: The ancient Hindu epic Mahabharata mentions a woman named Dimple, or 'Stri Dainika', who was a queen of the Vrishni dynasty. She was a devoted wife of the great warrior Bhishma and was known for her beauty and grace. The time period for this reference is approximately 4000 BC.
